description: This file implements the MDnsCache class for managing mDNS records, including caching, lookup, update, cleanup, and expiration logic within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: MDnsCache
classes.description: A class for caching and managing mDNS records, including methods for updating, lookup, cleanup, and expiration handling.

classes.name: MDnsCache::Key
classes.description: A class representing a unique key for mDNS records, based on type, name, and optional field.

methods.name: MDnsCache::LookupKey
methods.description: Looks up a record in the cache by key.

methods.name: MDnsCache::UpdateDnsRecord
methods.description: Updates or adds a DNS record in the cache, returning the update type.

methods.name: MDnsCache::CleanupRecords
methods.description: Removes expired or overfilled records from the cache.

methods.name: MDnsCache::FindDnsRecords
methods.description: Finds DNS records matching a given type and name.

methods.name: MDnsCache::RemoveRecord
methods.description: Removes a specific record from the cache.

methods.name: MDnsCache::GetOptionalFieldForRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the optional field for a record, e.g., ptrdomain for PTR records.

methods.name: MDnsCache::GetEffectiveExpiration
methods.description: Calculates the expiration time for a record based on its TTL.
